definition: NiuTrans is a machine translation system.
details: It has a platform, an API, and two open-source translation systems. It is developed by the Natural Language Processing Group at Northeastern University (China).
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is NiuTrans — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
